sentiment: An old game made new, a runtime swallowed whole, a machine that still cannot choose — the future arrives in familiar shapes.

stories.title: Cloudflare acquires Deno
stories.summary: The runtime built as an escape from the old web was folded back into the infrastructure it once resisted. Consolidation rarely feels dramatic from inside it — a familiar shape quietly absorbing the new one.

stories.title: Triple-A Minesweeper
stories.summary: A decades-old puzzle rendered as if it had a modern budget. Nothing new was invented — only the same old grid, lit better, and it landed harder than most novel work that day.

stories.title: Computers Cannot Make Decisions
stories.summary: A small essay reminding us that a machine weighs and outputs but never chooses. The deciding is still ours — which is exactly why a patient hand matters.
